title: Hey there! Welcome to my website.
text:
Hello! 😉
I’m Wenyu, a master student specializing in energy at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL).
Currently, I am living in Zürich for an internship at Hitachi Energy, having temporarily relocated from St-Sulpice VD, Switzerland.
Before 2023, I lived in Xi’an, China, where I completed my bachelor’s degree in energy storage at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU).
I speak Chinese, English and a little French.   我说汉语，英语和一点法语。 Je parle anglais, chinois et un peu français.
